payload.text: FOR intent-vc (asked 2026-10-24 after its compact): send intent-vc 0213's landing commit as soon as it lands, and later the release tag that carries it. Intent's dev/opt/brew thread is third in Intent's 3.2.7 queue, after Intent issue 0635 and Intent's devbin re-vendor. If a devbin release with 0213 is out before that re-vendor starts, Intent takes it instead of 0.1.13, so it re-vendors once. devbin's switch proof in the Intent checkout runs after that re-vendor (doctor per tree, upgrade only in a scratch clone). Intent is frozen until its v3.2.6 tag.
